info.title: Perch API
info.description: The Perch REST contract (spec §7.1). Versioned by the Perch-Version header; this document is the source of truth for the generated SDKs.

bearer.description: An api token (SDKs, the MCP server), a pk_ virtual key (/v1, /mcp), or a bot token.

token.description: Shown once; only a hash is stored.

accept_url.description: The accept link. Sent by email when PERCH_SMTP_URL is set; always returned to the inviter so it can be shared by hand.

get.description: Reports whether the api can serve requests and whether its database answers.

200.description: Healthy or degraded, with a check per dependency
The running version, commit, REST contract version, runtime, and mode
Which sign-in methods this instance offers

post.summary: Complete first-run setup: the admin account, the first workspace, the public URL, telemetry

201.description: Setup complete; the admin is signed in (session cookie)

get.summary: Workspaces the signed-in user belongs to

post.summary: Create a workspace; the creator becomes its owner

get.summary: A workspace the caller belongs to

patch.summary: Change a member's role (owners and admins; only owners touch owners)

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave (any member may remove themselves)

get.summary: The workspace audit log, newest first (owners and admins)

post.summary: Invite someone by email (owners and admins)

get.summary: Preview an invite before signing in

post.summary: Accept an invite as the signed-in user

get.summary: Runners a workspace may use, with live status

post.summary: Register a machine of your own and mint its connect token (shown once)

201.description: The runner, its connect token, and the command to run

delete.summary: Remove a runner (its owner, or a workspace admin)
